exclusion_criteria: Hard exclusions applied for: (1) acquired companies no longer trading independently, (2) invalid tickers, (3) programs with known termination/pauses, (4) factually incorrect claims, (5) critical financial/runway risk, (6) expensive valuation near 52-week high with poor risk/reward

excluded.exclusion_reason: Company acquired by Sanofi in 2021 for $1.1B. No longer trades independently. Ticker invalid.
Company acquired by Biogen in 2024 for $7.3B. No longer trades independently. Additionally, main asset (bardoxolone) had FDA CRL in 2020 showing regulatory risk history.
CDMO business model means catalysts depend on client timelines, not company's direct pipeline. Phase 3 timeline highly speculative and unpredictable. Not suitable as event-driven trade candidate.
Claim appears factually incorrect. Besremi (ropeginterferon alfa-2b) is developed by PharmaEssentia, not Bukwang Pharmaceutical. Cannot verify any Bukwang program that matches this claim.

COVID-19 vaccine market has evolved significantly since 2021-2022. Phase 3 studies for original COVID vaccines may no longer be relevant or commercially meaningful. Cannot verify if LG Chem has ongoing COVID vaccine phase 3 program relevant to 2026.

Critical cash runway risk (~10 months) with high dilution probability. Small-cap gene editing company with history of clinical setbacks and pipeline reprioritization. EDIT-301 phase 3 status and PDUFA timeline unverified. High execution risk combined with financing pressure creates unfavorable risk/reward.

Trading near 52-week high (only 7% below) with expensive valuation for entry. Combined with regulatory complexity history (Rivamer liver cancer therapy), Korean source inaccessibility, and marginal timing (D-132), this presents poor risk/reward. Price position red flag triggers hard exclusion.

Small KOSDAQ-listed cell therapy company with critical cash runway (~12 months) and high financing risk. Korean market access complexity combined with cell therapy manufacturing challenges and unverifiable catalyst timeline creates excessive risk profile for event-driven trade.

notes: Risk screening exclusions applied for (1) EDIT: critical runway <12 months with high dilution risk and clinical setbacks, (2) 069260.KS: trading near 52-week high with expensive valuation and regulatory complexity, (3) 950130.KQ: small KOSDAQ with limited runway and high market access risk. These represent hard risk filters that cannot be mitigated by position sizing.
